ref.description: A unique reference hash for the `PaymentRefund`.

payment_ref.description: The unique reference hash for the `Payment` to be refunded, as passed in the path params of the request.

funding_type.description:
A string that represents the type of tender. One of:

- `benefit`
- `credit_tpp`
- `credit_payfac`
- `ebt_cash`
- `ebt_snap`
- `wic`

created.description: A UTC timestamp that indicates when the `OrderRefund` was created, represented as an [ISO 8601 date-time](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) string.

updated.description: A UTC timestamp that indicates when the `OrderRefund` was last modified, represented as an [ISO 8601 date-time](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) string.

status.description:
The status of the refund. One of:

- `canceled`: The `PaymentRefund` object can’t be used.
- `expired`: The `PaymentRefund` has expired and can’t be used.
- `failed`: Check `receipt.message` for a description of the error.
- `processing`: The outcome of the refund is pending. _This status is not returned if you’re using Forage version `2024-01-08` or higher._
- `requires_confirmation`: The `PaymentRefund` requires confirmation before it can be processed. Contact Forage support to confirm this refund.
- `succeeded`: The refund has been successfully processed and will be included in settlement. It can’t be changed.

last_processing_error.description: The `code` and `message` values corresponding to the most recent [Payments API error](https://docs.joinforage.app/reference/errors#payments-api-errors).

receipt.description:
Most of the information that you're required to display to the customer, according to FNS regulations.

This field is `null` if the data that populates the receipt is not yet available.

The total amount paid by the customer is `snap_amount` + `ebt_cash_amount` + `other_amount`. This amount will be settled with the merchant after applying Forage's fees.

sequence_number.description: A unique sequence number for the transaction, emitted for POS Terminal refunds.

ErrorsArray.description: An array with information about the error.

code.description: A short string that represents the error.

message.description: A developer-facing message with more details about the error, not to be displayed to customers.

resource.description: The type of the Forage resource involved in the error.

ref.description: If applicable, the ten character reference hash of the Forage resource that caused the error. An empty string if no specific individual resource was involved.

details.description: Additional details about the error, if applicable.

ExternalOrderIDField.description:
A unique identifier for the order as created by the merchant or platform (not Forage).

When a merchant or platform passes this order ID to Forage, it persists in each Forage transaction related to the `Order`. This field enables merchants to map order IDs in their system to corresponding Forage `Order` IDs.

**You must build with Forage Version `2023-05-15` or later to use `external_order_id`.** Either pass `2023-05-15` as the `API-Version` header on a per request basis, or set the version for all requests in the Forage dashboard.

MetadataObject.description:
A required object containing merchant-defined key-value pairs to provide additional context for the payment.

Merchants should use this field to store **reference information** relevant to the transaction (for example, order details, system identifiers, or tracking data). This helps link the payment to records within their system.

Pass an empty object (`{}`) if no additional information is available.

> ⚠️ Personally Identifiable Information
>
> **Do not include personally identifiable information (PII)** such as names, emails, or payment details.

PaymentRefundRequest.description: This object represents a refund of a previously created Payment object. Funds will be refunded to the PaymentMethod originally charged.

amount.description:
A positive decimal string representing the amount of the `Payment` to refund in USD. If a partial refund, then this value does not need to equal the `amount` field of the original `Payment`. Precision is supported to the penny.

The minimum amount that can be refunded is `0.01`.

reason.description: A string that describes why the `Payment` is to be refunded.

merchant_fixed_settlement.description: The fixed amount in USD that should be restored to the merchant from EBT Cash payments prior to splitting by the `platform_fee`. Precision is supported to the penny.

platform_fixed_settlement.description: The fixed amount in USD that should be restored to the platform from EBT Cash payments prior to splitting by the `platform_fee`. Precision is supported to the penny.

pos_terminal.description:
⚠️  This param is required for POS Terminal refunds. It is not supported for online-only.

An object that details information about the POS Terminal that processed the payment.

provider_terminal_id.description: A unique string that identifies the POS Terminal.
